prompt: A gaunt necromancer in tattered wine-purple robes stands in side profile facing right, one skeletal hand outstretched. A thick stream of glowing crimson life-essence is torn from a kneeling, withering victim and arcs through the air into the necromancer, whose own flesh flushes healthy and full as he drinks it in. The victim slumps grey and drained. The background is a soot-black crypt lit only by the crimson glow of the streaming life-essence.

Extreme close-up on a dying soldier in dented steel plate, his greyish drained but still human face contorted in agony as ribbons of crimson life-essence are pulled out of his open mouth and chest, streaming away to the right out of frame. His skin withers and his eyes go pale white. The background is a dim battlefield at dusk, deep shadow, the only bright color the crimson essence leaving his body.

A dark sorceress in black-and-crimson robes, facing the viewer, head tilted back in ecstasy, both arms spread wide as crimson life-essence streams up out of two collapsed victims at her feet and pours into her chest. Her flesh glows with stolen vitality. The background is a moss-slicked stone dungeon, near-black, lit only by the crimson glow of the rising life-streams.

Two figures fully visible head to knee, the same size, facing each other in profile on a soot-black moor at night. On the left a hooded black-robed warlock, gaunt hand raised; on the right a kneeling armored knight collapsing, his life torn out as a bright crimson Lichtenberg-figure of life-essence bridges between them, flowing left into the warlock who stands taller and stronger. The only source of light is the crimson essence-arc connecting them.

A vampiric mage in a high-collared crimson-lined black cloak, three-quarter view, gripping a withering victim by the throat and lifting him as crimson life-essence visibly drains up the mages arm in glowing threads, the victim shrivelling to grey husk. The mages own face flushes ruddy and full. The background is a candlelit gothic hall, deep shadow, warm crimson highlights on the draining threads.

Low worms-eye view from the ground looking up at a towering black-robed warlock who looms over the viewer, one hand reaching down toward the camera. Crimson threads of life-essence are sucked out of the viewers own perspective and up into the warlocks palm. His face is lit ruddy and full from below by the crimson glow. The background is a towering night sky of churning black clouds.

A hooded black-robed sorcerer kneels on the left in side profile, palm pressed flat to the chest of a fallen grey-skinned creature sprawled on the right. Bright crimson life-essence pulses up his arm in glowing veins from the creature into him; the creature is shrivelling to a husk. The sorcerers free hand glows with absorbed crimson vitality. The background is a cracked obsidian altar floor in deep shadow, lit only by the crimson glow of the draining veins.
